name: moves
description: Moves: a mobility journal for everyday trips in Upper Austria (FH OÖ Interactive Media).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
